name: uni-t-uts
description: MCP server for UNI-T UTS1000B/UTS3000B spectrum analyzers over the local network (SCPI over LAN)

analyzer_host.title: Analyzer address
analyzer_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the analyzer, for example 192.168.1.100, or "auto" to discover it. Optional: leave it empty and ask Claude to connect to the analyzer at an address.

analyzer_port.title: Port
analyzer_port.description: TCP port of the raw SCPI connection. The analyzer uses 5025; change it only if yours differs.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: auto (VXI-11 when the analyzer offers it, otherwise raw), raw (TCP port 5025) or vxi11.
